result:
Round 161 **passes**: the library glyphs (◀ ▶ × ▾ ▸, Preview, Stop, Add, Playing) are now lucide icons, and nothing in the layout moved. I checked it in a real Chromium browser at 1440×900 and 1280×720. There are 0 bugs, and `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| Targeted tests | 334/334, the same as A; A's 4 new tests are green. |
| Source scope | HEAD is `aeba543`. The 968 frozen files and A's end hashes match at my start and end. Only the 11 allowed files changed, plus the new doc 130, so no protected file changed. No source changed while I was testing. |
| Code review of A's changes | Only the planned changes. No test assertion was removed. A changed one extra test line in `collection.test` (l.399); it swaps one check for an equivalent one and is not weaker. |
| Icons | Every site has one hidden-from-screen-readers lucide icon of the right type and size (12×12, or 10×10 for the row marker and fold button) and line width. Its colour follows the button (muted, then lighter on hover; gold on Preview/Add/marker). The square-box icons are exactly centred. No old glyph text is left anywhere in the library. The screen-reader names are as planned. |
| Layout (RV1 baseline) | No element moved: 0 px against round 160's baseline at both viewports, after the one expected rename (`＋ Add` → `Add`). |
| Library states | 0.000 px against B's pre-change measurements in all four states; a folded collection keeps its 16 px button and restores exactly when unfolded. |
| Library actions | Collapse/expand and search clear work, and focus goes where it should. Fold works. Preview plays real audio (output peak 0.1266) and shows Stop and Playing, which go away when stopped. Add puts one clip on the Music track with a single Undo step. Range delete now reads exactly `Deleted 00:01.000 — 00:02.000 on the Music track; the gap remains.` |
| Ready status | Reads exactly `Demo collection ready. Choose a track and add a sound (Enter or Add).` |
| Auth not bypassed | The demo page opens with no sign-in. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio. `/api/studio-token` returns 401. |
| Network and errors | 0 forbidden requests, 0 Authorization headers, 0 hydration errors, 0 page errors. |

- **Blocked:** the fake-Bearer 403 check, because the backend isn't available in the cloud.
- **One replaced load:** my first warm-up load hit the known cold-start error after the new icon imports ("Invalid hook call"). The task allows replacing it, and every load after that was clean.

Notes for B, none of them bugs:
- **Same colour:** the brand and accent colours are both the same gold (rgb 201,164,106) in Studio, so Stop and Preview look alike. This was already the case before this round.
- **Short names:** the screen-reader names `Preview`, `Stop` and `Add` are short. This is a signal for the polish pass.
- **Architecture note:** the reviewer's note about the icon class recipe being repeated across 10 sites is passed on unchanged.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop`; open `c-round-161.md` first.
